description: State government seeks AI solution to track housing allotment and construction progress for Indiramma Illu programme efficiently.
body_lead: The State government is scouting for a comprehensive artificial intelligence based solution that can help officials track allotment of new houses under the first phase of the Indiramma Illu, weaker section housing programme, and also monitor the progress of house construction. The government is looking at a cloud-based AI construction detection model which would be able to take input from various sources such as housing app inside smart phone or a camera live feed.
